versions.changelog:
Initial release of innovation-radar: R&D innovation detection and recommendation tool.

- Automatically identifies potential technical innovations from R&D reports, meeting notes, technical documentation, and experiment records.
- Provides structured innovation extraction, protection advice, value rating (novelty potential × technical integrity), and tailored follow-up questions.
- Generates professional HTML reports using a strict multi-section template for clear action and evidence presentation.
- Integrates MCP-based patent search for fast novelty screening, with well-defined triggering and handling rules.
- Distinct processing flows and output structures for R&D reports, meeting notes, and technical proposals.
- Designed to support pre-patent decision-making—helps teams recognize, assess, and organize promising innovation assets.
